text:
I’ve got a few errands to run in Hammerlocke.
Care to join me for the journey?\c
If you’re headed for the next Gym Stadium,
you’ll need to get to Hammerlocke, too, after all.[VAR 0114(0013)]
They say two’s company, after all.[VAR 0114(0013)]

I like that attitude, child.\c
Still, you’re in the middle of the Gym Challenge,
are you not?\c
You’ll need to head back to Hammerlocke either
way if you want to get to Circhester.[VAR 0114(0013)]
